name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for garage door frame repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for garage door frame repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience specifically in garage door frame repair, not just general garage door installation. Verify they are licensed and insured, especially important for structural work. Check their reputation through reviews or references. A good contractor will offer a detailed, written estimate after an on-site inspection, clearly outlining the scope of work, materials, and costs. Inquire about warranties on their work and materials. Choose a contractor familiar with local building codes and materials suitable for your area's climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose licensed and insured contractors with specific frame repair experience and good references. Request a detailed, written estimate, inquire about warranties, and ensure local code familiarity.
